scheme_name: Yatra Pass in DTC non AC Buses for the Construction Workers
description:
The Yatra Pass scheme for construction workers was launched by the Delhi government on August 1, 2021. 

This initiative is specifically aimed at providing affordable transportation options to construction workers in Delhi. 

The primary objective of the Yatra Pass scheme is to facilitate the daily commute of construction workers to their workplaces. 

The scheme aims to enhance the mobility of these workers who often face challenges in accessing public transportation due to high costs. 

The government has set a measurable target of issuing 50,000 Yatra Passes within the first year of the scheme's launch. 

This initiative is expected to significantly reduce the transportation costs incurred by construction workers. 

Under the Yatra Pass scheme, construction workers can avail of unlimited travel on non-AC DTC buses. 

The pass is valid for a duration of 30 days from the date of issuance. 

Construction workers can obtain the Yatra Pass for a nominal fee of INR 100. 

This fee is significantly lower than the average daily transportation cost for workers who rely on public transport. 

The scheme is designed to benefit construction workers who are registered with the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 

To be eligible for the Yatra Pass, applicants must be at least 18 years old. 

There is no upper age limit specified for the eligibility criteria. 

Applicants must also provide proof of their employment in the construction sector. 

This can include documents such as a work identity card or a letter from their employer. 

Additionally, construction workers must be registered with the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board to qualify for the Yatra Pass. 

The application process for the Yatra Pass is straightforward. 

Interested construction workers can apply online through the official website of the Delhi government. 

They must fill out an application form and upload the required documents. 

The required documents include proof of identity, proof of employment, and a recent passport-sized photograph. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

Upon approval, the Yatra Pass is issued electronically. 

Construction workers can also apply in person at designated centers across Delhi. 

These centers are equipped to assist workers with the application process. 

The Yatra Pass can be collected from these centers once it is approved. 

The scheme is expected to be reviewed annually to assess its impact and effectiveness. 

The Delhi Transport Corporation (DTC) is the implementing authority for the Yatra Pass scheme. 

DTC is responsible for the issuance of passes and ensuring the smooth operation of the scheme. 

For any inquiries or assistance, construction workers can contact the DTC helpline at 1800 180 8181. 

The Yatra Pass scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Delhi government to support the welfare of construction workers. 

In recent years, the government has introduced various schemes aimed at improving the living and working conditions of these workers. 

The Yatra Pass is expected to benefit thousands of construction workers in Delhi. 

According to estimates, there are over 1.5 million construction workers registered in Delhi. 

The majority of these workers rely on public transport for their daily commute. 

The introduction of the Yatra Pass is anticipated to alleviate some of the financial burdens faced by these workers. 

The scheme also aims to promote the use of public transport among construction workers. 

This aligns with the government's broader goals of reducing traffic congestion and pollution in the city. 

The Yatra Pass is valid for travel on all non-AC DTC buses operating within the Delhi metropolitan area. 

This includes both regular and limited-stop services. 

The pass allows for unlimited travel during its validity period. 

This means that construction workers can use the pass multiple times a day without incurring additional costs. 

The government has also emphasized the importance of safety and hygiene in public transport. 

DTC has implemented measures to ensure that buses are regularly sanitized. 

Passengers are also encouraged to follow safety protocols while traveling. 

The Yatra Pass scheme is part of the Delhi government's commitment to enhancing the welfare of marginalized communities. 

It reflects a growing recognition of the contributions made by construction workers to the city's development. 

The scheme is expected to be a vital resource for workers who often work long hours for minimal pay. 

By providing affordable transportation, the government aims to improve the overall quality of life for these workers. 

The Yatra Pass scheme is a significant step towards ensuring that construction workers have access to essential services. 

The government continues to explore additional measures to support this workforce. 

Future initiatives may include skill development programs and financial assistance for housing. 

The Yatra Pass is just one of many efforts aimed at uplifting the construction worker community in Delhi. 

Overall, the Yatra Pass scheme is a crucial initiative that addresses the pressing transportation needs of construction workers. 

It provides a practical solution to the challenges faced by this essential workforce. 

The scheme is expected to have a lasting impact on the lives of construction workers in Delhi. 

As the city continues to grow and develop, initiatives like the Yatra Pass will play a vital role in supporting its labor force. 

The Delhi government remains committed to improving the welfare of construction workers through targeted programs and policies. 

In conclusion, the Yatra Pass for construction workers is a well-structured scheme that addresses specific needs. 

It offers an affordable and accessible transportation solution for a vital segment of the workforce. 

The success of the Yatra Pass scheme will depend on effective implementation and ongoing support from the government. 

The Delhi government is optimistic about the positive outcomes of this initiative for construction workers.
